title: 23章：保他们平安喜乐
content_zh:
缓缓倒下的张琳琳，如同一朵盛开的鲜花，骤然遭逢疾风暴雨，在勉力支撑之后，终归还是在天地的嘶吼之中，黯然凋零。

    边关月的目中闪过一丝愧意，他本可以阻拦，可是，他也知道，救得回人，也终究是救不回她的心。

    若是李母未死，孩儿尚在，为了李右的老母和未降生的孩子，这个坚强的女子，无论如何都会强撑着活下去，已全二人之情。

    可惜，事实从来都没有如果。

    似乎，张琳琳的结局在李右撒手人寰之时，便是已成定局。

    张荼面色阴冷地看着张琳琳，胸口插着的匕首已然渗出了大片的殷红，就像是盛开的牡丹，而此时张琳琳的面容之上，再无痛苦之意，反而带着淡淡的笑意。

    是啊，这个世界，除了李右，又有谁还值得她留恋的呢？

    她虽与李右无名无分，可是与那王茂，又有着什么名分，干干净净的来，终究亦是干干净净的离去。

    张欢欢抱着张琳琳的身躯，已然哭成泪人。右手不断的按着匕首，可是张琳琳本就是生命垂危，如今冷锋入心，早已没了生机，不过是徒劳无功的无力挽回罢了。

    看着眼前的惨淡场景，徐团集一时间无言，只觉得胸口像是哽住了一般，说不出的难受与压抑，时间大变方两日，却是已然出现如此惨剧在眼前。

    那，没有看到的局面，究竟有多少呢？

    哭之声从王庄村口传来，原是王茂父母在弟兄的传信之下，得知了王茂被人杀死在了庄口，这才纠集本家，一路哭哭啼啼的而来。

    可惜，他们来晚了，在知道事情的前因后果之后，徐团集只觉得王茂一家都该死，可是军装在身，身为护国军，哪怕心中在厌恶，终归是不能以自己的喜好来裁决所遇到之事，更别说他自身本就没有这个权利。

    张王二庄的人，在年轻和苍老的哭声之中对峙，而徐团集所代表的护国军亦是有意和稀泥，不愿插手其中，是故最终不了了之，二庄各自回家置办丧事。

    当张荼抱着张琳琳的尸首回到李家宅院之时，未曾出面的张家长辈早已在不断回来报信的小辈口中了解了现场的一切。

    “开棺！”

    张荼的声音低沉且不容置辩。

    而一干小辈也不管是否合理，但是对于张荼的话语却是唯命是从，毕竟张荼的所作所为，得到了他们所有人的认可。

    “杀了我张荼的兄弟，你就该死！”

    不管是偏激也好，冲动也罢，至少张荼的选择，很对年轻人的胃口。

    跟着张庄人一路回来的徐团集，在路上已然知道张荼是从城区返回，而今天地大变，有一个能带路的人也好，当看到张荼的开棺举动之时，眼中也不由得透露出一丝满意。

    生不能厮守，那死便同穴罢！

    由于老李家在庄上除了母子俩外再无其他亲眷，而今更是值天地大变，是故也没有按照以往的常理，仅仅只是草草地盖棺，葬在了老李的坟旁。

    “兄弟，而今，你也算是家庭团圆，只可惜，未能见到我的大侄子。”
content_en:
Zhang Linlin fell slowly, like a blooming flower that was suddenly hit by a violent storm. After struggling to hold on, she withered sadly amid the roar of heaven and earth.

    A trace of guilt flashed in Bian Guanyue's eyes. He could have stopped her, but he also knew that even if he could save her, he could not save her heart.

    If Li You's mother had not died and the child was still alive, for the sake of Li You's old mother and unborn child, this strong woman would have managed to live on no matter what, and the two of them would have loved each other.

    Unfortunately, there is never an if.

    It seemed that Zhang Linlin's fate was a foregone conclusion when Li You passed away.

    Zhang Tu looked at Zhang Linlin with a cold expression. The dagger inserted in his chest had already oozed a large amount of bright red, like a blooming peony. At this time, there was no pain on Zhang Linlin's face, but a faint smile.

    Yes, in this world, besides Li You, who else is worthy of her nostalgia?

    Although she has no name or connection with Li You, what kind of relationship does she have with Wang Mao? She came cleanly and left cleanly in the end.

    Zhang Huanhuan hugged Zhang Linlin's body and cried into tears. She kept pressing the dagger with her right hand, but Zhang Linlin's life was already in danger. Now that Leng Feng had entered her heart, she had already lost her life. It was just a futile effort to save her.

    Looking at the bleak scene in front of him, Xu Tuanji was speechless for a moment. He only felt as if his chest was choked. He was indescribably uncomfortable and depressed. Time had changed drastically in just two days, but such a tragedy had already happened before his eyes.

    So, how many unseen situations are there?

    The sound of crying came from the entrance of Wangzhuang Village. It turned out that Wang Mao's parents learned that Wang Mao had been killed at the entrance of the village through a message from their brothers, so they gathered the family and came all the way crying.

    Unfortunately, they arrived late. After knowing the cause and effect of the matter, Xu Tuanji only felt that Wang Mao and his family deserved death. However, wearing a military uniform and being a national protector, even if he felt disgust in his heart, he could not judge the things he encountered according to his own preferences, let alone that he did not have this right.

    The people of Zhangwang's Second Village were confronting each other amidst the cries of the young and the old, and the National Protectorate Army represented by Xu Tuanji was also deliberately at odds with each other and did not want to get involved. As a result, the story was left unsolved, and the two villages went home to arrange their own funerals.

    When Zhang Tu returned to the Li family's residence with Zhang Linlin's body in his arms, the elders of the Zhang family who had never come forward had already learned everything about the scene from the younger generations who kept coming back to report.

    "Open the coffin!"

    Zhang Tu's voice was low and unarguable.

    The juniors didn't care whether it was reasonable or not, but they obeyed Zhang Tu's words. After all, Zhang Tu's actions were recognized by all of them.

    "You deserve to die if you kill my brother Zhang Tu!"

    Whether it is extreme or impulsive, at least Zhang Tu's choice is very suitable for young people.

    Xu Tuanji, who followed the people from Zhangzhuang all the way back, already knew on the way that Zhang Tu was returning from the city. The situation had changed greatly today. It would be great if there was someone who could lead the way. When he saw Zhang Tu's action of opening the coffin, his eyes could not help but reveal a trace of satisfaction.

    If we can't stay together in life, then we will die in the same hole!

    Since Lao Li's family had no other relatives except the mother and son in the village, and the world was undergoing great changes, they did not follow the common practice in the past and just built a coffin hastily and buried it next to Lao Li's grave.

    "Brother, now you can be considered a family reunion. It's a pity that you haven't been able to see my eldest nephew."
title_en: Chapter 23: Keep them safe and happy
